title: Agent Hooks — reserved host_error:* reasons
description: Host-synthesized deny reasons (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §11). Interceptors MUST NOT emit reasons with the host_error: prefix.

reasons.cause: Host could not construct a schema-valid AgentContext.
An interceptor raised or returned a non-JSON value.
An interceptor exceeded the host timeout.
An interceptor returned a value that fails §5 validation.
transform.path did not resolve or value could not be set.
transform.path is not rooted at $target, or the interception point forbids transform.
escalate verdict with no registered approval resolver.
Approval resolver raised or timed out.
Approval resolution context_identity did not match the request.
The host adapter cannot emit this interception point.
Host cannot assemble a streaming response before post_model_call.
